units.source_text: 我并没有马上回住处，因为回老家之前还有些东西要买，

en.t: I did not return to my lodgings right away, because there were still a few things I had to buy before going home,

units.source_text: 再者也需让吃得满满的胃消化消化，于是向着热闹的大街走去。

en.t: and I also needed to let my overfilled stomach digest a little, so I walked toward the lively main street.

units.source_text: 天刚刚擦黑，在闲逛的人群中，我遇到一个当天跟我一起毕业的同学。

en.t: Dusk had just fallen, and among the people strolling idly about, I ran into a classmate who had graduated with me that day.

units.source_text: 他不由分说把我拉进一家小酒吧，在那里我不得不听了一晚上他那啤酒沫般的夸夸其谈，

en.t: Without giving me a chance to object, he dragged me into a small bar, where I had to spend the whole evening listening to his beer-foam-like boasting,

units.source_text: 回到宿处时已经十二点多了。

en.t: and by the time I returned to my lodgings, it was already past midnight.
